declared_before: any CellTypist annotation of PBMC 3k was run (only the model's 32 cell-type names had been listed)
metric: fraction of cells in each author louvain group whose Immune_All_High majority-voting label is in the accepted set; overall = cell-weighted mean
notes: NK cells are grouped under the high-level 'ILC' category in CellTypist's Immune_All hierarchy (assumption stated in advance; checked against Immune_All_Low below). Low-resolution (Immune_All_Low) results are reported descriptively via the crosstab, not scored.
